obligations.requirement: VisibilityResolver derives the canonical SceneQuery from FrameState.worldViewport and returns the G2 query result's final back-to-front order; callers cannot supply a visible list.
obligations.oracle: Exercise the production resolver with distinguishable viewports and records whose spatial candidate order does not define their SceneOrderKey order.
obligations.acceptance: The exact viewport world rect reaches Scene::query and VisibilityResult contains the deterministic G2 back-to-front order.

obligations.requirement: A normal render visibility resolve over 100000 scene records and approximately 500 visible records remains localized and performs no SemanticDocument traversal.
obligations.oracle: Build a real G2 Scene with a 100000-record spatial fixture, resolve a viewport covering approximately 500 records, and inspect SceneQuery diagnostics and production dependencies.
obligations.acceptance: Visible count is approximately 500, examined candidates are materially below total records, resolver output visits only the query result, and production includes no semantic document or object-store traversal dependency.
obligations.evidence_required: Locality counter JSON plus focused test and boundary-scan output.

obligations.requirement: Changing only per-view camera/viewport state invalidates and recomputes visibility without mutating SemanticGeneration or RuntimeScene content.
obligations.oracle: Resolve two distinguishable FrameState values against the same canonical Scene and RuntimeScene identity and compare before/after canonical content.
obligations.acceptance: Visibility membership changes while scene generation, read token, RuntimeScene generation, cardinality, and exact records remain unchanged.

obligations.requirement: G3-02 introduces no Demo/Shell visibility input, SemanticDocument scan, Tile coverage, or G3-03+ behavior.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned dependency scan over exact changed production and test files plus full G2 and G3-01 regression.
obligations.acceptance: Forbidden dependency scan is empty and all frozen predecessor tests pass.
obligations.evidence_required: Boundary scan and predecessor regression logs.
